keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «고양이 미미가 말을 했다(놀라운 일)» 와 «그래서 화요일이 가장 좋아하는 날이 되었다(결말)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the surprise (my cat Mimi talks) and the ending (Tuesday is now my favorite day). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: My cat Mimi can talk, but only on Tuesdays.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

sum.pre: One morning, my cat Mimi starts to
: the big dog next door is afraid of
. Now Tuesday is my favorite day!

words: a small tool for eating soup or cereal
something you tell only a few people
The big dog next door is afraid of mice.
I laugh and give her a fish.
to make a happy sound when something is funny
Now Tuesday is my favorite day, because my cat can talk!

qs.q: Why do I drop my spoon?
opts: The big dog barks at me.
evs: One morning, my cat Mimi says, "Good morning!"
Dad sings in the shower every night.
I laugh and give her a fish.
why: «One morning, my cat Mimi says, "Good morning!"» 고양이가 말을 해서 깜짝 놀라 숟가락을 떨어뜨려요.
My cat Mimi says, "Good morning!" I am so surprised that I drop my spoon.

qs.q: "But only on Tuesdays." What does "only" mean here?
qs.qko: «But only on Tuesdays.» 에서 «only» 는 무슨 뜻일까요?
opts: on Tuesdays and no other days
on every day of the week
evs: Now Tuesday is my favorite day, because my cat can talk!
I drop my spoon. "You can talk?"
Then Mimi says, "Now give me more fish, please."
The big dog next door is afraid of mice.
why: «Now Tuesday is my favorite day, because my cat can talk!» 미미가 화요일에만 말을 해서 화요일이 제일 좋아요. «only» 는 «~에만» 이라는 뜻이에요.
Mimi talks only on Tuesdays, so Tuesday is my favorite day. "Only" means on that day and no other day.

qs.q: What secrets does Mimi tell me?
qs.qko: 미미는 나에게 어떤 비밀을 말해 주나요?
opts: The dog next door is afraid of mice, and Dad sings in the shower.
Mom hides cookies, and the dog can fly.
Mimi can swim, and Dad can dance.
evs: The big dog next door is afraid of mice.
Dad sings in the shower every night.
Then Mimi says, "Now give me more fish, please."
why: 옆집 큰 개는 생쥐를 무서워하고(«The big dog next door is afraid of mice.»), 아빠는 밤마다 샤워하며 노래해요(«Dad sings in the shower every night.»). 두 문장을 이어야 알 수 있어요.
The big dog next door is afraid of mice, and Dad sings in the shower every night. You need both sentences.

ends: On Wednesday, Mimi talks again and tells a new secret.
수요일에도 미미가 또 말을 하고 새 비밀을 알려 준다.
I tell Dad that Mimi can talk, but Mimi only says, "Meow."
아빠에게 미미가 말을 한다고 알려 주지만, 미미는 «야옹» 이라고만 한다.

write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «하고 싶은 일 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what you want to do and your reason in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because my friend likes it)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write who + what to make your reason clear. (e.g. because my friend likes it)
write.src: “I want to <u>talk with my cat</u> because <u>she knows many secrets</u>.”

img.cover: In a sunny kitchen in the morning, a chubby orange tabby cat with green eyes and a white chest sits on the breakfast table and opens her mouth wide as if talking, while a girl with a short black bob and a yellow headband in a blue striped shirt drops her spoon in surprise and a little splash of milk flies up from her cereal bowl.

scenes.1: In a cozy living room, a chubby orange tabby cat with green eyes and a white chest whispers into the ear of a girl with a short black bob and a yellow headband in a blue striped shirt, who giggles, while through the window a big brown dog next door jumps back in fright from a tiny gray mouse in the yard.
scenes.2: In a sunny kitchen, a girl with a short black bob and a yellow headband in a blue striped shirt laughs and holds out a small fish to a chubby orange tabby cat with green eyes and a white chest, who stands up on her back legs with a happy, hungry face.
